# What does this PR do?
Support THD and sequence packing for NCCL EP by
- Find the max per-EP rank token through either config (THD) or read during runtime (BSHD)
- Mark the masked/padded token's destination to -1 and zero their probs so NCCL EP will not route them

NCCL EP natually support uneven num tokens across EP rank so there is no need to allreduce and pad to max.

## Strict review: [NCCL EP] Support THD and sequence packing for NCCL EP

The PR has the NCCL EP manager size its buffers from a config bound for packed (THD) input: `max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank`, or the new `ModelParallelConfig.seq_length`. It also routes padded rows to `-1` with zero weight, and threads `packed_seq_params` down to the flex dispatcher.

The main eager path works as intended. One supported schedule never receives `packed_seq_params`, and the bound can still differ between ranks. Both affect correctness across EP ranks.

**Findings: CRITICAL 1, IMPORTANT 1, SUGGESTION 1.** Each inline comment has the full failure case, the fix, what must keep working, and acceptance checks.

1. **[CRITICAL Correctness]** `packed_seq_params` never reaches `preprocess` on the EP A2A-overlap path ([moe_layer.py#L545](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/moe_layer.py#L545)).
   - **Where:** the eager `overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm` path in [gpt/fine_grained_callables.py#L138-L140](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/models/gpt/fine_grained_callables.py#L138-L140) still calls `preprocess` with four positional arguments. The PR updated both CUDA-graph replay overlap branches in `transformer_layer.py`, but not this one.
   - **Effect:** with ncclep and THD on this path, `_is_thd` stays `False`. The bound comes from each rank's own first microbatch, so EP ranks bootstrap with different arguments. Larger microbatches later raise a `RuntimeError` telling the user to raise `seq_length`, which has no effect on this path.
2. **[IMPORTANT Correctness]** `_dispatch_token_bound` mixes in a per-rank value ([token_dispatcher.py#L2000](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher.py#L2000)).
   - **What:** `max(bound, self.num_local_tokens)` uses this rank's own count. `ensure_nccl_ep_bootstrapped` requires identical arguments on every EP rank ([fused_a2a.py#L901-L903](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/fused_a2a.py#L901-L903)).
   - **Effect:** if the configured bound is too small on only some ranks, those ranks bootstrap with different values instead of all failing with one clear error.
3. **[SUGGESTION Other]** The new over-bound `RuntimeError` gives a fix that only applies to THD ([token_dispatcher.py#L2089-L2094](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher.py#L2089-L2094)). For BSHD input, and on the overlap path in finding 1, raising `seq_length` changes nothing.

**Checked, no issue found:**
- Every `_DispatchManager.setup_metadata` override takes the new keyword arguments. The unused parameters are documented as ignored in the abstract method.
- The `padding_mask` transpose and flatten matches the `[s, b]` token order, consistent with HybridEP's existing assert and the router's mask handling.
- The ceiling arithmetic for SP, CP and TP matches the five unit-test expectations.
- The bound check and log run only at bootstrap, with no new device sync or per-step overhead.
- The NCCL EP determinism test is covered by the existing `moe_token_dispatchers` manifest entry.
- The `GPTModelConfig` / `HybridModelConfig` `__setattr__` precedence change avoids the `seq_length` proxy clobbering. In the args path, both copies of `seq_length` come from `args`.
- Adding `seq_length` to the `arguments.py` exclude list avoids a duplicate `--seq-length`.

**Overall risk: moderate.** The default (non-overlap) eager path works as intended. The gaps are the overlap schedule and the rank-dependent bootstrap bound.

**Coverage and limitations:**
- All 10 changed files were reviewed.
- Topic A (NCCL EP manager internals) was covered by a delegated child, and its findings were re-checked against the source.
- The child reports for topic B (`packed_seq_params` call sites) and topic C (`seq_length` config plumbing) were never delivered to me. I reviewed those topics myself: `moe_layer.py`, `transformer_layer.py`, both `fine_grained_callables.py`, `model_chunk_schedule_plan.py`, the overlap validation in `transformer_config.py`, `arguments.py`, `training/models/{base,gpt,hybrid,deepseek_v4}.py`, and the `MLATransformerConfig` fields that overlap with the model configs.
- **Not inspected:**
  - whether the HybridStack and MTP layers forward `packed_seq_params` into MoE on the non-overlap path;
  - `core_transformer_config_from_args`;
  - other config-snapshot tests.
- TransformerEngine's `ep_bootstrap` and `-1` handling were not inspectable here.
- No tests were run. Every check below is either a proposed test or reasoning from the source.

**[IMPORTANT Correctness]** The THD bound depends on this rank's token count, but NCCL EP bootstrap requires the same value on every rank.

**Failure**
- **What the code does:**
  - `bound = max(bound, self.num_local_tokens)` takes this rank's first THD microbatch count.
  - `_ensure_bootstrap` ([L2022-L2049](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher.py#L2022-L2049)) rounds it and passes it, plus the `_recv_capacity` derived from it, to `ensure_nccl_ep_bootstrapped`.
  - Every dispatch then builds `new_nccl_ep_buffer(max_tokens_per_rank=self._max_tokens_per_rank)`.
  - [fused_a2a.py#L901-L903](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/fused_a2a.py#L901-L903) requires identical arguments on every EP rank.
- **Trigger:**
  - THD input, ep=2, cp=1, no SP, `seq_length=256`, `max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank=None`.
  - The first microbatch has 300 tokens on rank 0 and 200 on rank 1.
- **Actual:** rank 0 bootstraps with 320 and rank 1 with 256. TE gets mismatched collective arguments, so the behaviour is undefined (a hang or a buffer-layout mismatch). Rank 0 also silently accepts a count above the configured bound.
- **Expected:** one `max_tokens_per_rank` shared by the whole group.
- **Scope:**
  - This needs a configured bound that is too small on only some ranks.
  - The packing schedulers cap per-rank tokens at `max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank`.
  - The case named in the code comment, inter-document masking with mbs>1, is uniform across ranks.

**Correction**

Reduce the THD bound with MAX over `self.group` once, and cache it so a later re-bootstrap (`grow_recv_capacity`, the paged-stash rerun) issues no new collective. Add `self._thd_token_bound: Optional[int] = None` in `__init__`, then:
```python
        bound = max(bound, self.num_local_tokens)
        if self._thd_token_bound is None:
            # NCCL EP bootstrap and every EpBuffer need one max_tokens_per_rank across the group;
            # num_local_tokens is rank-local.
            bound_tensor = torch.tensor([bound], dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
            torch.distributed.all_reduce(
                bound_tensor, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MAX, group=self.group
            )
            self._thd_token_bound = int(bound_tensor.item())
        bound = self._thd_token_bound
```
- **To verify before adopting:** that each manager's first `_ensure_bootstrap` runs outside CUDA-graph capture. The zero-copy assert at L2061-L2063 and the TE barrier suggest it does.
- **Collective-free alternative:** drop the `max()` and raise at bootstrap when `num_local_tokens > bound`. That removes the mbs>1 case, so its parametrization (expected 3008) would have to change.

**Preservation**
- The BSHD branch still returns early with no collective.
- `max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank` still takes precedence over `seq_length`.
- The ceiling divisions by TP under SP, and by CP×TP for `seq_length`, are unchanged.
- The `ValueError` when neither bound is set is still raised first.
- In the mbs>1 case all ranks already agree, so the reduction is a no-op.

**Acceptance**
- **Existing tests:**
  - In `_ncclep_manager_stub`, set `manager._thd_token_bound = None`.
  - In the THD cases of `test_ncclep_bootstrap_token_bound`, monkeypatch `torch.distributed.all_reduce` to a no-op, because the stub group is `object()`.
  - The expected values must stay 128 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 3008.
  - `test_ncclep_thd_requires_a_sequence_length_bound` must still raise `ValueError`.
- **Proposed multi-GPU test:**
  - Use the `test_ncclep_thd_uneven_tokens` setup with `seq_length=256`.
  - Make the first `round_trip` 300 tokens on rank 0 and 64 on the other ranks.
  - All-gather `_comm_manager._max_tokens_per_rank`: it must be 320 on every rank, and the round trip must succeed.

**[SUGGESTION Other]** This error suggests a fix that only applies to THD.

**Failure**
- For non-THD input, `_dispatch_token_bound` returns the first microbatch's count ([L1982-L1983](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher.py#L1982-L1983)), and config values play no part.
- **Trigger:** BSHD with 128 tokens per rank in the first microbatch and 192 in a later one. The overlap path described in the `moe_layer.py` comment ends up the same way.
- **Actual:** the error tells the user to raise `max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank` or `seq_length`, which changes nothing.
- **Expected:** a fix that matches where the bound came from.

**Correction** (replace L2089-L2094):
```python
        if hidden_states.shape[0] > self._max_tokens_per_rank:
            remedy = (
                "raise max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank or seq_length to the real per-rank maximum"
                if self._is_thd
                else "non-packed (BSHD) inputs are sized from the first microbatch, so later "
                "microbatches must not carry more tokens per rank"
            )
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"'ncclep' dispatch got {hidden_states.shape[0]} tokens on this rank, above the "
                f"{self._max_tokens_per_rank} its NCCL EP buffers were sized for at bootstrap; "
                f"{remedy}."
            )
```

**Preservation**
- The THD message is unchanged.
- `pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="sized for")` in `dispatcher_thd_uneven_tokens_test` still matches.

**Acceptance** (proposed stub test):
- Setup: `_ncclep_manager_stub()` with `_bootstrapped=True`, `is_nccl_ep_bootstrapped` monkeypatched to return True, and `_max_tokens_per_rank=128`.
- With `_is_thd=False`, `dispatch` on a 192-row tensor raises a message that contains "first microbatch" and not "seq_length".
- With `_is_thd=True`, the message contains "seq_length".
- The check runs before `new_nccl_ep_buffer`, so the test needs no NCCL EP.

# What does this PR do?
Support THD and sequence packing for NCCL EP by
- Find the max per-EP rank token through either config (THD) or read during runtime (BSHD)

## Strict review: [NCCL EP] Support THD and sequence packing for NCCL EP

The PR has the NCCL EP manager size its buffers from a config bound for packed (THD) input: `max_seqlen_per_dp_cp_rank`, or the new `ModelParallelConfig.seq_length`. It also routes padded rows to `-1` with zero weight, and threads `packed_seq_params` down to the flex dispatcher.

The main eager path works as intended. One supported schedule never receives `packed_seq_params`, and the bound can still differ between ranks. Both affect correctness across EP ranks.

**Findings: CRITICAL 1, IMPORTANT 1, SUGGESTION 1.** Each inline comment has the full failure case, the fix, what must keep working, and acceptance checks.

1. **[CRITICAL Correctness]** `packed_seq_params` never reaches `preprocess` on the EP A2A-overlap path ([moe_layer.py#L545](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/moe_layer.py#L545)).
   - **Where:** the eager `overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm` path in [gpt/fine_grained_callables.py#L138-L140](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/models/gpt/fine_grained_callables.py#L138-L140) still calls `preprocess` with four positional arguments. The PR updated both CUDA-graph replay overlap branches in `transformer_layer.py`, but not this one.
   - **Effect:** with ncclep and THD on this path, `_is_thd` stays `False`. The bound comes from each rank's own first microbatch, so EP ranks bootstrap with different arguments. Larger microbatches later raise a `RuntimeError` telling the user to raise `seq_length`, which has no effect on this path.
2. **[IMPORTANT Correctness]** `_dispatch_token_bound` mixes in a per-rank value ([token_dispatcher.py#L2000](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher.py#L2000)).
   - **What:** `max(bound, self.num_local_tokens)` uses this rank's own count. `ensure_nccl_ep_bootstrapped` requires identical arguments on every EP rank ([fused_a2a.py#L901-L903](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/fused_a2a.py#L901-L903)).
   - **Effect:** if the configured bound is too small on only some ranks, those ranks bootstrap with different values instead of all failing with one clear error.
3. **[SUGGESTION Other]** The new over-bound `RuntimeError` gives a fix that only applies to THD ([token_dispatcher.py#L2089-L2094](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d7494d69008302f7f2cab0d3592c20d11efa0856/megatron/core/transformer/moe/token_dispatcher.py#L2089-L2094)). For BSHD input, and on the overlap path in finding 1, raising `seq_length` changes nothing.

- Every `_DispatchManager.setup_metadata` override takes the new keyword arguments. The unused parameters are documented as ignored in the abstract method.
- The `padding_mask` transpose and flatten matches the `[s, b]` token order, consistent with HybridEP's existing assert and the router's mask handling.
- The ceiling arithmetic for SP, CP and TP matches the five unit-test expectations.
- The bound check and log run only at bootstrap, with no new device sync or per-step overhead.
